name: Monitor Input
author: Matthew Flower
description: Switch the active input on a DDC/CI monitor from the Omarchy bar, using friendly names instead of DP-1 / HDMI-2.

barWidget.description: Icon plus a popup that lists your configured monitor inputs and switches to the one you pick.

schema.label: ddcutil display number
schema.description: Which display to drive, as numbered by `ddcutil detect`. 0 lets ddcutil pick.

schema.label: I2C bus number
schema.description: Drive the monitor on this /dev/i2c-N bus instead (`ddcutil --bus N`). Wins over the display number; useful behind docks that don't pass DDC/CI through. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Show input name in the bar
schema.description: Print the active input's friendly name next to the icon.

schema.label: Scroll brightness step
schema.description: How far a scroll over the bar icon moves monitor brightness. 0 disables scroll control.

schema.label: Config file
schema.description: Path to the inputs JSON. Empty means ~/.config/ddc-input-select/inputs.json.
